# list_llm_tools_tool

> List available custom LLM Tools for the tenant with their status and configuration.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `llm_tools` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=list_llm_tools_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

List available custom LLM Tools for the tenant with their status and configuration.

This tool helps discover what custom tools are available including:
- Tool name, description, and active status
- Input schema for parameters
- Configuration fields
- Agent associations

EXAMPLES:
List all tools: {}
List active tools: {active_only: true}
Find tools for an agent: {agent_id: 123}
Find by name: {name: "fetch"}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active_only` | boolean | no | Only show active tools. |
| `agent_id` | integer | no | Filter by tools assigned to a specific agent. |
| `name` | string | no | Filter by tool name (partial match) |
